text:
marta: thinking aloud — we should prototype a lightweight token ownership checker that ties an API key/service token back to org/project/service-account and shows recent routing/quotas. would be super helpful for support + billing :eyes:
chris: +1. UX idea: quick lookup by token id, show last 7 days of requests, top endpoints, assigned quota bucket, and current SLA tier. RBAC so only people with audit role can see provenance.
ian: do we want realtime introspection (authz call per request) or offline batch mapping? realtime = accurate but adds latency.
tori: realtime for lookup tool is fine; for per-request path avoid extra sync calls. cache introspect results for 5m in a churn-safe KV.
sara: mapping token->org is sensitive. TTL mappings (30d) and redact PII in logs. legal signoff if retention >90d.
marta: proposed plan: 1) read-only Console dashboard (admins) that hits internal endpoint GET /internal/tokens/{id}/ownership returning minimal fields (owner_org, owner_project, sa, last_seen, quota_bucket, routing_hint). 2) telemetry: emit anonymized routing tags, not token. 3) sample 1% of requests for full traces linking routing decisions to token types.
chris: keep introspect cheap. example response (pseudo) we expect: {"owner_org": "acme-corp", "owner_project": "acme-web", "service_account": "sa-ingest-1", "last_seen": 1712341200, "quota_bucket": "reserved-50k", "routing_hint": "dedicated-pool-us-west"}
tori: storage: prefer a time-series KV w/TTL (redis eviction + write-through from auth-db). avoid heavy joins in the dashboard.
ian: rollout: gate dashboard behind a feature flag, initially SRE/support opt-in. audit-log every lookup (who asked for token->owner).
marta: Console UX idea: one-click "reassign" (requires owner-admin) and quick "revoke" action hitting POST /internal/tokens/{id}/revoke showing downstream quota impact.
sara: revokes must create immutable audit events stored in compliance logs and optionally copied to customer audit if configured.
deploy-bot: campaign deploy started for feature/ownership-checker (canary: 10%) — build 3721 succeeded :party-parrot:
chris: estimates: backend proto 2d, frontend 1d, schema migration if persisting snapshots ~3d total. i'll open a PR for endpoints and docs stub.
tori: sampling knob per env. dev 10% to help debugging, prod 1%.
ian: add weekly reconciliation job to detect orphaned tokens (>90d no last_seen) and mark stale in UI; optionally email org owners.
marta: i'll draft RFC with API contract, retention defaults, RBAC matrix and tag @chris to lead PR.
chris: on it. will add CI rule to prevent logging full token strings in dashboard logs.
